view_reviews.reference_observation: S-curved single-edged blade (elven style curved sword) with an elegant upward sweeping tip, wide belly, and distinct stylized guard collar fitting leading into a tapered handle and flared pommel.
view_reviews.candidate_observation: Nearly straight blade with a rigid polygonal blocky outline, lack of fluid curvature or upward tip sweep, generic handle with blocky circular collar rings and flat pommel.

mismatches.evidence: The candidate blade lacks the smooth sweeping upward curve towards the tip and stylized wide belly seen in the reference.
mismatches.correction_goal: Curve the blade upward towards the tip and refine the spine/edge silhouettes to match the organic curved elven sword profile.

mismatches.evidence: The candidate's guard area consists of a simple symmetrical ring collar rather than the stylized angled collar guard of the reference.
mismatches.correction_goal: Reconstruct the hilt collar to reflect the angled, integrated guard form from the reference video.

analysis.decision_reason: The candidate fails to match the iconic curved silhouette and specific component design of Grant Abbitt's curved sword, presenting an overly straight, generic blade blockout.
limitations: Single side view available for evaluation.

claim_boundary: This remote VLM review may reject or localize visible mismatches. It cannot prove topology, hidden geometry, professional quality, or human acceptance.
